simple.meaning: מַעֲלָל (maʻălâl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an act (good or bad).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 28:20. The surrounding context includes birth, family, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַעֲלָל (H4611) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַעֲלָל (maʻălâl) / H4611 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:20, Judges 2:19, 1 Samuel 25:3, Nehemiah 9:35 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H4611. maalal [ מַעֲלָל ] 41 noun masculine Neh 9:35 deed, practice ; — only plural מַעֲלָלִים 1Sam 25:3 ; construct מַעַלְלֵי Psa 77:12 ; 78:1 ; suffix מַעֲלָלֶיךָ Deut 28:20 , מַעֲלָלָיו Hosea 4:9 +, מַעַלְלֵיכֶם Isa 1:16 +, מַעַלְלֵיהֶם 3:10 +, etc.; — 1 usually (especially Jeremiah 17 t.) bad practices of men, מַעֲלָלִים רַע 1Sam 25:3 he was evil in his practices ; Judg 2:19 (|| דֶּרֶךְ ), Hosea 5:5 ; 7:2 ; Isa 3:8 ; Jer 11:18 ; Psa 106:29 ; 106:39 (|| מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם ); ׳מ הָרָעִים Neh 9:35 ; מ ׳רֹעַ the evil of your (their, etc.) practices Hosea 9:15 ; Isa 1:16 ; Jer 4:4 ; 21:12 (suffix 3 masculine plural Kt, 2 masculine plural Qr), +; ׳מ הָרָעִים Zech 1:4 Qr (+ ׳ד הָרָעִים ; Kt מעליליהם ), ׳מ טוֺבִים לֹא אֲשֶׁר Ezek 36:31 (+ id. ); מ ׳הֵרֵעוּ Micah 3:4 ; מ ׳מְּרִי , i.e. their consequences, Isa 3:10 ; Jer 17:10 ; 21:14 ; 32:19 (+ דֶּרֶךְ ). 2 deeds of ׳י Psa 77:12 , of אֵל 78:7 ; compare Micah 2:7 . 3 acts , in General, of youth Prov 20:11 (|| מָּעֳלוֺ ). [ מעליל ], מעליליהם Zech 1:4 Kt, see foregoing 1

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.
Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.
For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.
Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings.
I will also meditate on all your work,
that they might set their hope in God,
Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds.
Thus they were defiled with their works,
Even a child makes himself known by his doings,
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean.
For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen;
Tell the righteous “Good!”

Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
“Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness; for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”
Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.
“I, Yahweh, search the mind.

“Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.” ’
House of David, Yahweh says,
House of David, Yahweh says,
I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahweh;

Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says Yahweh.
But if they had stood in my council,
saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.
It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way; that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’
Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God’s voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.
great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them, then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers:’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

Thus Yahweh could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.
“ ‘ “Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
It will be, like people, like priest;
Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God;
They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness.
“All their wickedness is in Gilgal;
In the womb he took his brother by the heel;
Shall it be said, O house of Jacob:
Then they will cry to Yahweh,
Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein,

Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear, nor listen to me, says Yahweh.

But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers?
